description: This script enables the 'translatable' property for specific fields in various doctypes within an ERP system, likely ERPNext. It reloads the relevant document definitions and updates property setters for fields like Customer Name, Supplier Name, Contact Name, Item Name/Description, and Address.

methods.name: execute()
methods.description: Main function to enable translatable property on specified fields by reloading document definitions and inserting property setter records.
